title: He Told His Nanny To Cut Off A Man's Arms . . . He Was Nine (Part 2)
caption:
A nine-year-old gave one cold order, and his nanny cut a man's arms off 😳 Part 2 of Swordmaster's Youngest Son. Follow for Part 3!

#swordmastersyoungestson #manhwarecap #manhwa #webtoon #regression #comicrecap #recap #fyp
credit: Swordmaster's Youngest Son (Hwangze Penguin / Mr. Big / AZI)
comment: Was Jin right to give that cold order, or did he go too far? 👀 Comment below 👇

segments.say: A nine-year-old boy orders his nanny to *kill* one man, and cut the other man's arms off.
Jin Runcandel was reborn with a god's power, and now a dragon *serves* him.
Murakhan, the guardian dragon, sleeps no more. Jin sneaks into the secret *library* to see him.
Months pass. Murakhan lies around eating pastries while Jin studies *books* nobody else can read.
Then Murakhan says something. If you want power, you must learn to release your *shadow force*.
But first, Jin needs two skills. Mana release, and mana *transfer*.
Murakhan says it will take two or three years. Jin can't *wait* that long.
So he does it in one try. A glowing ball of mana appears in his *hand*.
The dragon finally shows him real shadow force. Shadows pour out of the *floor*, swirling around Jin.
Murakhan smiles. You, too, can become the master of all *shadows*.
Far away, a white-haired knight cuts down an army. She is Jin's eldest sister, *Luna*.
Six months later, the twins turn ten and leave Storm Castle. Jin is finally *alone*.
Then Jin turns nine, and his nanny Gilly brings him a strawberry *cake*.
But the party stops. A white-haired woman walks in unannounced. Lady Luna has *come*.
In his past life, she was more like a stranger than family. So why is she *here*?
Jin answers honestly. I feel guarded, because I have never seen you this *close*.
Then she kneels in front of him. I forgot you are a Runcandel too. *Sorry*.
Luna warns him. The moment you leave Storm Castle, every sibling will *target* you.
Luna admits that someone already tried to assassinate her too. She will not step away from the *fight*.
Then she grips his arms. Tell me, Jin! Who tried to kill you? And Jin whispers, I cannot *tell* you.
Luna hugs him tight, and for the first time, she looks *soft*.
Then she hands him a gift. A blue gem pendant, for his ninth *birthday*.
Shatter the gem, and she will come to him, no matter where he is. But it works only *once*.
The dragon trembles. That pendant belongs to the demon beast king, and it *blocks* all spells below five stars.
Then a new magic teacher arrives. But the patriarch sent him to *evaluate* Jin.
Back in his room, Jin pokes a candle, and fire *bursts* from his finger.
That night, Jin sneaks out to say goodbye. Murakhan grins. I will follow you *anywhere*.
I am the dark dragon of legends! I will follow you without getting noticed, so don't *worry*.
At dawn, Jin and Gilly step into the snow. Two guardian knights wait to *escort* them home.
But the snow gets heavy, and the ride turns rough. Then the horses *scream*.
Twenty enemies swarm the carriage. But Gilly senses the guardian knights are *fake*.
Gilly drags Jin into the snowy woods. I will protect you, she says, as a Runcandel *vassal*.
Then a red-haired man arrives with soldiers. He says the clan sent him to *rescue* Jin.
The guardian knights are impostors. So Jin gives a cold order. Kill one, and cut the other's *arms* off.
Gilly answers, As you command. Then she lunges, and her claws *flash*.
In seconds, one impostor lies dead in the snow. The other screams as his arms are *cut* off.
Gilly drags the survivor to Jin's feet. Your master underestimated his *target*.
The man spits blood and laughs. This is only a warning! The age of the Runcandels will *end*!
Jin's eyes go *cold*. I want the Age of Jin Runcandel to come.
The man hails the great Zeifl, a clan that has hated the Runcandels for a thousand *years*.
Jin praises Gilly. But the red-haired captain Murca whispers, he doesn't sound like a *kid*.
Gilly blames herself. Jin says, even the nine-star knight Kahn missed the *disguises*.
In his past life, Gilly was thrown out of the clan the same day he was *banished*.
She never blamed him. She only bowed and said, I could not serve you *better*.
So he orders her to stop blaming herself. Right now, she is the only guardian knight he *has*.
Gilly smiles through her tears. Yes, young master. I'll do my *best*.
At the inn, Murca guesses who made the impostors. A man named Bubarre, the *Transfigurator*.
Bubarre can transform other people, which even dragons cannot do. His crimes spread *chaos*.
In his past life, Bubarre was arrested at twenty. If Jin recruits him first, he could be *useful*.
Then Jin falls asleep. A loud meow wakes him. A black *cat* scratches the window.
Jin opens the window, and the cat stares at him. It is *Murakhan*.
Then Murakhan pops into human form, trips, and crashes through the *floor*.
Gilly slams the door open. How dare you attack the young *master*!
Her eyes glow red. Speak, before I shred you into a million *pieces*!
Murakhan stares at her. Gilly? Did you say Gilly? My strawberry *pie*! We finally meet!
Murakhan calls her his strawberry pie. And Gilly is about to shred a *dragon*.
